question: Sector breakdown for the Balanced Portfolio
Which portfolio has the largest AUM?

args.sql: SELECT portfolio_name, total_aum FROM portfolios ORDER BY total_aum DESC LIMIT 1
args.title: Portfolio with the largest AUM

question: Top 3 holdings by market value in the Small Cap Value Fund

args.title: Top 3 holdings by market value in Small Cap Value Fund
args.sql: SELECT s.company_name, (h.quantity * s.current_price) AS market_value FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Small Cap Value Fund' ORDER BY market_value DESC LIMIT 3

question: Average Sharpe ratio of each portfolio over the period

args.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, AVG(pp.sharpe_ratio) AS average_sharpe_ratio FROM portfolio_performance pp JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id
args.title: Average Sharpe ratio of each portfolio

question: Show sector exposures for all high risk portfolios

args.title: High risk portfolios
args.sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level = 'High'
